name: Vending_Machine_Status
script:
# Server Script: Vending_Machine_Status
# REST API: GET /api/method/Vending_Machine_Status (login required)
frappe.response["message"] = frappe.db.get_all(
    "Vending Machine",
    fields=[
        "machine_id",
        "machine_name",
        "status",
        "is_online",
        "last_heartbeat",
        "linked_warehouse",
    ],
    order_by="machine_id",
)

name: Vending_Low_Stock_Check
script:
# Server Script: Vending_Low_Stock_Check
# REST API: GET /api/method/Vending_Low_Stock_Check (login required)
frappe.response["message"] = frappe.call("vending_tracker.utils.vending_utils.get_low_stock_slots")
